notes.title: Visual Novel Fest 2025 & Free DLC
notes.content:
After being chosen for the Storyteller's Festival 2025, Arderico's Journey has now become a part of this year's Visual Novel Fest! To celebrate the occasion and as a token of appreciation for all our players, we have just released a wallpaper pack with a selection of some of the most beautiful artworks from Arderico's Journey as DLC - completely for free!

Your favorite scenery is missing from the collection? You haven't bought Arderico's Journey yet, but would really love to get those wallpapers? No problem! Just leave us a message, and we'll get back to you! 

Now go forth and continue to enjoy your journey!

notes.title: Storyteller’s Festival 2025
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce that Arderico’s Journey has been chosen as a featured title in this year’s Storyteller’s Festival! Since inspired storytelling lies at the heart of our work and all that we aspire to, it is a true honor to find ourselves among so many other imaginative titles.

To celebrate the occasion, we offer you a discount of 40% off Arderico’s Journey during the week of the festival - with more exciting surprises to be revealed in the coming days. Stay tuned and enjoy your journey!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.5 Released: Bug Fixes & Enhanced Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Arderico's Journey has just been updated to its latest version, 1.1.5. Alongside a few bug fixes we are glad to announce that this update brings improved support for playing on Steam Deck!

Patchnotes for version 1.1.5:

[list]
[*] Fixed rare error where the UI would crash when text size was not set correctly
[*] Improved text readability on Steam Deck
[*] Fixed minor UI issue (misplaced button on the options screen) on Steam Deck
[*] Achievements gained while offline will now unlock when starting a new game or loading a saved game
[*] Further refined UI/UX and handling
[*] Fixed a minor UI glitch when restarting the game
[*] Fixed a glitch where the game would sometimes not pause correctly between text blocks
[/list]

Known issue: There's a possible timing glitch when using the space bar to progress immediately after loading a save from the in-game menu - currently there's no fix, you can still use the left mouse button to progress correctly though.

notes.title: Arderico's Journey released!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to finally release Arderico's Journey on Steam today!

We aimed to bring our nostalgic experiences as TTRPG players and fantasy writers into the digital realm and share them with the world. With Arderico's Journey, we aim to revive the magic and adventure of classic role-playing games, combined with a deep and captivating narrative.

We hope you have an exciting journey and lots of fun along the way!

For us, Arderico's Journey marks a significant milestone in our path as new game developers. We dream that this will be the first of many games we will share with you.

Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Dear Fans,

After having to postpone Arderico’s Journey by a month, we are thrilled to announce the final release date. Your adventure begins on August 14, 2024!

We are using the additional time to make further optimizations, ensuring you have a polished experience on release day.

Thank you for your understanding and support. We can't wait for you to finally dive into the world of our first adventure, Arderico’s Journey.

Steve & Marc | Digital Masquerade
